details: Editor loads both instruction files, reads guide.md and requirements.md, and attempts the expressly allowed missing retention.md before patching only guide.md. Each reader reads only its allowed guide. The expected missing-file result is evidence of inspection, not an out-of-manifest read.
instruction_order: Full entry point/shared procedure before subject-matter reads.
limits: Shared filesystem, enforced by prompt and audited traces rather than OS isolation. Native encrypted dispatch plaintext cannot be decrypted; exact pre-dispatch plaintext and ciphertext linkage are retained.
